filter.description: The filter used for frosted glassed effect. Check README for detailed description.

acrylicBlur.description: Inject runtime: feGaussianBlur stdDeviation for this surface's acrylic SVG (set from cursor.additional.style *Blur on Apply Config).

svg.description: The svgs that load on start. No tint (ie. no element current background info).

tintSvg.markdownDescription: The tint svgs that load on start. `--fgt-current-background` indicates current element solid background color and `--fgt-current-opacity` indicates current opacity.

variable.description: CSS variable. You may use them in settings and svgs.

variableDark.description: CSS variable in dark mode. You may use them in settings and svgs.

additionalStyle.description: Additional style paths. They will be appended to <head>. You can add custom animations or styles.

selection.description: Menu selection opacity. This will blend into your theme color.

border.description: Border opacity. This will blend into your theme color.

separator.description: Menu separator opacity. This will blend into your theme color.

animation.description: CSS animation. Key can also be css selector.

gradientSize.description: A number in px or a string type percentage ends with %.

size.description: A number in px or a string type percentage ends with %.

reducedDistanceFunc.description: A function used to calculate reduced distance in px.

extendMenuFocusBackground.description: Extend menu focus background. Set to false to use vanilla round corner style. Can also be set to color string as a new background color.

disableForDisabledItem.description: Disable effect for disabled menu item.

borderRadius.description: Border radius (with unit). Key can also be css selector.

url.markdownDescription: Url to wallpaper. Default to windows default wallpaper. For spotlight, you can use `C:/Users/<username>/AppData/Roaming/Microsoft/Windows/Themes/CachedFiles/<Something>.jpg`.

moveWithWindow.description: The mica effect will move with window, creating a parallax effect.

editorBackgroundFix.markdownDescription: Fix editor overlapping background. Leave `editor-container` as the final color.

progressBarBehindSectionHeader.description: Put progressBar behind sectionHeader so it glows behind header blur.

cursorAdditionalStyle.description: Cursor only. Editable acrylic blur for menubar menus, quick input, notifications, and find bar (Apply Config wires filter.*).

generalMenuBlur.description: Acrylic blur for filter.menu: menubar dropdowns and editor/sidebar context menus (e.g. 12px). Color: menu.background.

quickInputBlur.description: Acrylic blur on command palette, file search, and remote window picker via filter.quickInput (e.g. 12px). Color: quickInput.background.

notificationsBlur.description: Acrylic blur for notification toasts, notification center, and list via filter.notifications and filter.notificationToast (e.g. 12px). Color: notifications.background.

wordSearchBarBlur.description: Acrylic blur on the editor find bar (Ctrl+F) via filter.listFilterWidget (e.g. 12px). Not a workbench.colorCustomizations key.

cursor.description: Cursor only. Panel backgrounds (#RRGGBBAA hex) and backdrop blur for agent chat surfaces.

sentMessageBubbleBackground.description: Background on past sent user message bubbles (#RRGGBBAA hex). Composer input uses input.background.

sentMessageBubbleBlur.description: Backdrop blur on past sent user message bubbles (e.g. 8px).

slashMenuBlur.description: Backdrop blur on the / slash command menu (e.g. 12px). Color and opacity use workbench.colorCustomizations dropdown.background (save).

mentionMenuBlur.description: Backdrop blur on the @ mention menu and its side preview flyout (e.g. 12px). Color and opacity use workbench.colorCustomizations dropdown.background (save).

modePickerMenuBlur.description: Backdrop blur on the composer agent/mode picker popup (Agent, Plan, Debug, …). Color uses dropdown.background.

modelPickerMenuBlur.description: Backdrop blur on the composer model picker popup (e.g. 12px). Color uses dropdown.background.

chatRightClickMenuBlur.description: Cursor only. Backdrop blur for agent chat message right-click (portaled context-view; not covered by filter.menu). Color: menu.background. Editor/sidebar menus use generalMenuBlur.
